title: This is the ‘most underappreciated’ driver for Microsoft’s business, according to one analyst
summary: Investors understand Microsoft’s cloud-computing opportunities, but may not be giving enough credit to the revenue potential of its software business.

title: I’m in my 50s. My mother died from Alzheimer’s. Do I need long-term-care insurance?
summary: “By the time my mother died, the insurance company had paid out almost $600,000.”

title: Many young adults can only afford to invest thanks to the bank of mom and dad
summary: Parents are providing help with expenses like housing and groceries, and sometimes directly investing for their children, to give them a head start in a challenging economy.

title: I just started dating someone I really like, but he’s moving to Mexico for six months. Should I spend the money to visit him?
summary: “Traveling is something we both want in a partnership.”

title: It’s almost impossible to sell a condo unit these days: ‘I feel trapped’
summary: Selling a condominium unit has become a challenge for many, as buyers get spooked at the prospect of bearing ever-rising HOA fees — even if the home comes with a lower price tag.

title: AMD hits a major milestone as AI stocks blaze higher
summary: AMD has become the 14th U.S. company to see its market capitalization top $1 trillion.

title: AI is a Pandora’s box that some CEOs seem wary of opening — at least with investors
summary: Corporate America may be broadly using AI, but an analyst noted that some management teams are hesitant to bring it up with investors because it won’t translate to financial results just yet.

title: AT&T’s stock looks like the smartest bet in the wireless sector, analyst says

title: My husband and I are in our 50s and have no kids. We have $2 million in IRAs and 401(k)s. Do we really need a will?
summary: “We have no debt and own our primary home, a vacation home, as well as my mother’s home in another state.”

title: ‘She says it’s just money’: My friend pays for everything. I should be grateful, but I can’t stand her anymore.
summary: “On each of these weekends away, she’s probably spending $500.”
